basic_details.job_title: District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup Government Pleader Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Advocates with at least 10 years of practice can apply for the post of Government Pleader in Kamrup, Amingaon. Applications go to the District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon, and must be submitted on or before 30 November 2026 by 4.00 P.M. The Office of the District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon issued the notice on 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Kamrup District Court Government Pleader
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon. Applications are invited under letter No. E-187327-PER-36/103/2026-KPER/26 dated 18/11/2026, received from the District Commissioner, Kamrup, Amingaon. The notice has been sent to the Lawyers' Associations of Kamrup (Amingaon), Rangia, Hajo and Boko for circulation in the Bar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to the undersigned, the District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon. It must be submitted on or before 30 November 2026 by 4.00 P.M. The notice does not prescribe an application form or a postal mode, and it does not say what to write on the envelope. It does not mention submission by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for the post of Government Pleader in Kamrup, Amingaon. It does not print the number of posts or the pay. Who can apply: interested Ld. Advocates. Length of practice: not less than 10 years. Educational qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Applicants must still submit a document indicating their educational qualification. Age limit: not specified in the notice. Applicants must still submit a document indicating their age. For the full wording of the eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice asks applicants to send supporting documents with the application: A document indicating age A document indicating Enrollment No. A document indicating educational qualification A document indicating address A document indicating length of practice An affidavit indicating any cases pending against the applicant The notice lists these documents followed by "etc.", so applicants may include other supporting documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kamrup Government Pleader post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 30 November 2026 by 4.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the Government Pleader post in Kamrup, Amingaon?
faq.answer: Interested Ld. Advocates can apply. Their length of practice must be not less than 10 years.

faq.question: Q3. How much practice is needed for the Kamrup Government Pleader post?
faq.answer: The length of practice must be not less than 10 years.

faq.question: Q4. Where should the Kamrup Government Pleader application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application goes to the District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon, who signed the notice.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be attached to the Government Pleader application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach supporting documents indicating age, Enrollment No., educational qualification, address and length of practice. They must also attach an affidavit indicating any cases pending against them.

faq.question: Q6. Is an affidavit required for the Kamrup Government Pleader application?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must submit an affidavit indicating any cases pending against them.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the Government Pleader post located?
faq.answer: The post of Government Pleader is in Kamrup, Amingaon.

faq.question: Q8. On whose letter were the Kamrup Government Pleader applications invited?
faq.answer: Applications were invited as per letter No. E-187327-PER-36/103/2026-KPER/26 dated 18/11/2026, received from the District Commissioner, Kamrup, Amingaon.
